title: Subscribe to the calendar
description: Subscribe to the appointments once in your phone calendar. New, changed and cancelled appointments then appear automatically, without adding each one by hand.
copyFailed: Copying is not possible. Please select the link by hand.
linkOnce: For security reasons you only see this link now. Copy it into your calendar right away.
howToMac: Mac: If no subscription dialog appears, open Calendar and choose Calendar, Settings, General, then select Apple Calendar as the default calendar app. Alternatively, choose File, New Calendar Subscription and paste the link.
howToApple: iPhone/iPad: Settings, Calendar, Accounts, Add account, Other, Add subscribed calendar, then paste the link.
howToAndroid: Android: In Google Calendar on a computer, Other calendars, From URL, then paste the link. The calendar then also shows on the phone.
regenerated: New subscription link created. The old link no longer works.
alreadyActive: Your subscription link is already active. For security reasons it is not shown again. If you no longer have it, create a new link; the old one then stops working.
